reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis aligns well with current understanding of high-entropy alloys, though multiple factors can influence mechanical properties beyond lattice distortions, so there is minor uncertainty.
reasons.testability: It outlines a clear test comparing RHEAs and a lower-entropy counterpart under well-defined conditions with specific, falsifiable measurements.
reasons.usefulness: Researchers can directly use the proposed comparison to validate the role of lattice distortions in high-temperature performance, making this highly relevant and actionable.
